# Gemini Japanese

> Modern Japanese learning platform covering JLPT N5 through N1, kanji, grammar, vocabulary, and interactive exercises.

## Overview
Gemini Japanese provides comprehensive Japanese learning tools, spaced repetition flashcards, JLPT practice, reading exercises, and AI-powered grammar and translation assistants.

## Endpoints
- Homepage: https://translate.nevatal.tech/
- API Health: https://translate.nevatal.tech/api/health
- API Catalog: https://translate.nevatal.tech/.well-known/api-catalog
- Authentication Guide: https://translate.nevatal.tech/auth.md
- Sitemap: https://translate.nevatal.tech/sitemap.xml
